promotions.title: Batch API — 50% discount
promotions.detail: 'Batch' pricing tab halves every per-token price vs Standard. Tooltip: 'High-volume processing, at half price, for maximum efficiency.' FAQ: 'Batch processing, for high-volume work, reduces the price by 50%.' Standing discount, no end date shown.

promotions.title: Cached input tokens — up to 90% off input
promotions.detail: 'Configure your API' toggle labelled '-90% ON INPUT TOKENS': 'Ideal for repeated prompts, cutting input costs by 90%.' Applying it reduced every model's input price to exactly 10% (e.g. Medium $1.5 → $0.15). Standing discount, no end date.

promotions.title: Free plan — $10/mo in API credits
promotions.detail: Free plan includes '$10 /mo in API credits' plus access to Mistral Studio.

promotions.title: Pro plan — $14.99/mo incl. $30/mo API credits
promotions.detail: Pro: $14.99/mo excluding taxes; includes '$30 /mo in API credits', all-day coding in CLI/IDE/web (Mistral Vibe).

promotions.title: Team plan — $24.99/user/mo incl. $50/mo API credits
promotions.detail: Team: $24.99/user/mo excluding taxes; includes '$50 /mo' in API credits, up to 30GB storage per user.

promotions.title: Student discount — Pro at $5.99/mo
promotions.detail: FAQ: 'Verified students can get Mistral Pro for $5.99 / month (normally $14.99).' Requires student verification; no end date stated.

promotions.title: Mistral Moderation 2 — free
promotions.detail: Classifier service for text content moderation listed as 'Free' (mistral-moderation-2603).

promotions.title: Leanstral — free API endpoint
promotions.detail: LABS model labs-leanstral-2603, 'API endpoint: Free'.

promotions.title: Batch API 50% discount
promotions.detail: Batch processing runs asynchronous request batches with a 24-hour to 7-day processing window. "Pricing is at a 50% cost discount compared to synchronous API pricing." Docs also state: "The batch discount does not stack with prompt caching discounts. All batch tokens are billed at the 50% batch rate regardless of cache status." Standing feature, not time-limited.

promotions.title: Prompt caching 50% off cached input tokens
promotions.detail: Automatic prefix caching on supported models, no code changes and no additional fees. Docs: cache hits reduce "token costs by 50% for cached portions"; "Pricing discount will only apply on successful cache hits." Standing feature, not time-limited (type approximated; no discrete promo category fits).

promotions.title: Free tier
promotions.detail: Groq offers a Free plan with lower rate limits ("Free Plan Limits" section on the Rate Limits page) before upgrading to the pay-as-you-go Developer tier. No published free token quota amount. New Developer-tier users are billed progressively at $1/$10/$100/$500/$1,000 lifetime-usage thresholds rather than receiving a credit grant; no charge is issued below $0.50.

promotions.title: Occasional promotional credits
promotions.detail: Billing FAQ: "Are there promotional credits, or trial offers?" — "Yes! We occasionally offer promotional credits, such as during hackathons and special events." No amount, no eligibility rules, and no end date published.

promotions.title: $1 in free credits for new serverless users
promotions.detail: Serverless Inference section: "Pay per token, with high rate limits and postpaid billing. Get started with $1 in free credits."

promotions.title: Batch inference 50% discount
promotions.detail: "Batch inference is billed at 50% of serverless pricing on both input and output." Applies to all serverless text/vision models listed above; no end date shown.

promotions.title: GPU compute: On-demand GPU pricing increase from Sep 1 (current lower rate through Aug 31)
promotions.detail: On-demand GPU/hour table has two columns, "PRICE ($) PER HOUR - UPTO AUG 31" and "PRICE ($) PER HOUR - FROM SEP 1": H100 80GB $7.00 -> $8.00; H200 141GB $7.00 -> $8.00; B200 180GB $10.00 -> $13.00; B300 288GB $12.00 -> $15.00; GB300 288GB $18.00 -> $20.00. GPU-hour pricing, not per-token. Year not stated on page; observed 2026-08-26. (GPU-hour pricing, not per-token)

promotions.title: Serverless Training API checkpoint storage free during private preview
promotions.detail: "Checkpoint storage for serverless models is included during private preview." Training product, not text-generation inference.

promotions.title: Free Trial
promotions.detail: Get started with $5 in free credits after making an account. Access to all Cerebras powered models, community support via Discord.

promotions.title: Batch API discount
promotions.detail: Batch API inference costs are 60% of the standard model price, ideal for large-scale tasks with low real-time requirements. Supported models: kimi-k2.7-code, kimi-k2.6, kimi-k2.5. Tasks must complete within the specified completion_window.

promotions.title: $5 voucher on $5 cumulative recharge
promotions.detail: To prevent abuse, you need to recharge at least $1 to start using, and when your cumulative recharge reaches $5, you will receive a $5 voucher. Vouchers do not count towards the cumulative recharge total.

promotions.title: MiniMax-M3 Permanent 50% off
promotions.detail: Red "Permanent 50% off" badge on both MiniMax-M3 rows (≤512k and >512k input), applied on both the Standard and Priority tabs. List prices are struck through and the half-price figures are shown as effective. Standard ≤512k: $0.60→$0.30 in / $2.40→$1.20 out / $0.12→$0.06 cache read. Standard >512k: $1.20→$0.60 / $4.80→$2.40 / $0.24→$0.12. Priority ≤512k: $0.90→$0.45 / $3.60→$1.80 / $0.18→$0.09. Priority >512k: $1.80→$0.90 / $7.20→$3.60 / $0.36→$0.18. No end date stated — labelled "Permanent".

promotions.title: Token Plan — Plus
promotions.detail: Monthly Token Plan subscription via Subscription Key. "Personal projects and prototyping". 5-hour rolling and weekly quota windows; 3-4 agents. Covers the full MiniMax lineup (M3 / M2.7 / image / speech); MiniMax H3, voice design and rapid voice cloning not supported.

promotions.title: Token Plan — Max
promotions.detail: Monthly Token Plan subscription. "Daily coding with agents and multimodal work". 5-hour rolling and weekly quota windows; 4-5 agents.

promotions.title: Token Plan — Ultra
promotions.detail: Monthly Token Plan subscription. "Heavy Agent workflows and extended sessions". 5-hour rolling and weekly quota windows; 6-7 agents.

promotions.title: 首次开通免费额度（免费资源包）
promotions.detail: 首次开通腾讯混元大模型服务后发放一次性免费资源包：文本/视觉模型共100万 tokens（Hunyuan-a13b、Hunyuan-role-latest、Hunyuan-translation、Hunyuan-translation-lite、Tencent HY Vision 1.5 Instruct、Hunyuan-turbos-vision、Hunyuan-t1-vision、Hunyuan-turbos-vision-video 共享消耗）；Hunyuan-embedding 单独100万 tokens。资源包有效期1年，自开通服务之日起1年内未用完则过期作废。结算顺序：免费资源包 > 付费资源包 > 按量后付费。欠费或违规停服期间不能享受免费额度。

promotions.title: 缓存存储限时免费 (cache storage free for a limited time)
promotions.detail: Every flagship text model row lists 缓存存储 (cache storage, 百万tokens/小时) as 限时免费 — free for a limited time. Cache-hit reads (缓存命中) are still charged at the listed per-1M rate. No end date shown.

promotions.title: GLM Coding Plan — Lite (连续包年, 7折)
promotions.detail: Yearly auto-renew, 30% off list monthly rate (¥118/月 → ¥82.6/月).

promotions.title: GLM Coding Plan — Pro (连续包年, 7折)
promotions.detail: Yearly auto-renew, 30% off (¥538/月 → ¥376.6/月).

promotions.title: GLM Coding Plan — Max (连续包年, 7折)
promotions.detail: Yearly auto-renew, 30% off (¥1078/月 → ¥754.6/月).

promotions.title: 搜索工具 新品上线限时抢4折体验包
promotions.detail: Banner under 搜索工具服务 on the pricing page: "新品上线限时抢4折体验包，立享优惠" — limited-time 60%-off (4折) trial resource pack for the search tool service. Links to https://open.bigmodel.cn/tokenspropay?productIds=product-fa675d. No price or end date shown on the pricing page.

promotions.title: 尝鲜秒杀专区 — GLM-5.2 resource pack (2000万 tokens)
promotions.detail: Flash-sale token pack for GLM-5.2: 20M tokens, 有效期 3个月 (3-month validity), 限购 1 次 (limit 1 per user). ¥39.9 vs list ¥80 (≈5折). Daily limited quantity, 低至3折.

promotions.title: 尝鲜秒杀专区 — GLM-5.2 尊享包 (1亿 tokens)
promotions.detail: Flash-sale token pack for GLM-5.2: 100M tokens, 有效期 3个月, 限购 1 次. ¥189.9 vs list ¥380 (5折).

promotions.title: 开发者专区 — 开发者专享资源包，7折起
promotions.detail: Developer zone resource packs from 30% off. Text-relevant packs listed are vision/OCR/image/video only (GLM-4.6V ¥16 vs ¥20; GLM-4.6V-FlashX ¥8 vs ¥10; 联网搜索 2千次 ¥70 vs ¥100; GLM-OCR ¥8 vs ¥10). 有效期 3个月, 限购 3 次.

promotions.title: 企业专区 — 企业大容量资源包，低至7折
promotions.detail: Enterprise large-capacity resource packs as low as 30% off, 有效期 4个月, requires 企业认证 (enterprise verification). E.g. GLM-4.6V 5亿tokens ¥800 vs ¥1000; 联网搜索 10万次 ¥3500 vs ¥5000.

promotions.title: 教育专区 — 高校师生专享低至6折
promotions.detail: Education zone for university faculty/students, as low as 40% off. E.g. GLM-4.6V 1000万tokens ¥16 vs ¥20; 联网搜索 2千次 ¥60 vs ¥100; GLM-Image 500次 ¥35 vs ¥50. 有效期 3个月, 限购 3 次.

promotions.title: GLM-5.3 上线 — 邀好友送大额资源包
promotions.detail: "'GLM-5.3'重磅升级：核心能力全面提升，邀好友送大额资源包！邀请好友注册认证，狂得2亿最新模型Tokens！" — referral promo: invite friends to register+verify and receive up to 200M tokens of the newest model. No end date shown.

promotions.title: Batch API -50%
promotions.detail: 50% off input and output for async tasks completed within 24h.

promotions.title: Data residency +10%
promotions.detail: Regional/US-only processing adds 10% to standard rates.

promotions.title: Batch processing -50%
promotions.detail: Save 50% with batch processing.

promotions.title: Opus 5 fast mode
promotions.detail: Up to 2.5x faster at 2x standard pricing.

promotions.title: US-only inference +10%
promotions.detail: US-region workloads at 1.1x input/output.

promotions.title: Code execution free tier
promotions.detail: 50 free container-hours/day per org, then $0.05/hr.

promotions.title: Free tier (AI Studio)
promotions.detail: Free input/output with limited model access via Google AI Studio (data used to improve products).

promotions.title: Batch API -50%
promotions.detail: 50% cost reduction on the paid tier.

promotions.title: Off-peak 50% discount
promotions.detail: 50% off all tokens outside peak hours (peak = 01:00-04:00 & 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri).

promotions.title: GPT-5.6 Luna 80% price cut / Terra 20% cut
promotions.detail: On 2026-07-30 OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna to $0.20/$1.20 per 1M (input/output) and Terra by 20%.

promotions.title: Claude Sonnet 5 introductory price made permanent
promotions.detail: Launched at $2/$10 per 1M as introductory pricing; Anthropic made the rate permanent on 2026-08-11 (the scheduled Sept 1 increase to $3/$15 was cancelled).

promotions.title: Bailian Coding Plan / Token Plan
promotions.detail: Coding Plan from ¥200/mo; Token Plan Team Edition from ¥198/mo (multi-seat). New purchases currently Pro tier only.

promotions.title: Ark Coding Plan Lite first month ¥9.9
promotions.detail: Coding Plan Lite ¥40/mo, first month ¥9.9 (daily flash sale); Agent Plan = multimodal + Harness bundle.

promotions.title: GLM Coding Plan Pro annual 30% off
promotions.detail: Coding Plan Pro ¥149/mo, ¥104/mo on annual billing; plans from ¥49/mo.

promotions.title: MiniMax Token Plan from ¥29/mo
promotions.detail: Full-modal bundle (text + audio + video) from ¥29/mo.

promotions.title: Gemini API free tier
promotions.detail: Rate-limited free tier for prototyping on Flash/Flash-Lite models.

promotions.title: Off-peak discount window
promotions.detail: Reduced rates 16:30-00:30 UTC daily; V4-Pro ~$0.66/$1.98 off-peak vs $1.32/$3.96 peak per 1M since 2026-08-16.

promotions.title: New-account free token grant
promotions.detail: Reported 5M free tokens for new API accounts (verify in console).
